verdictText: APPROVE for OWNER-RULING at the exact head, with no blocking finding or required in-PR change; carry-forwards remain explicitly routed.
reservedSlot: The original admission manifest reserved this review slot; it now binds the genuine full sensitive review.
reviewerRows: | CF-MPRU-1: co-op ServerMatchHost.recover reads units from disk, not HTTP | YES. recover() calls deriveServerAdaptedUnits(state) for co-op AND non-co-op (OBS-MPRU-1 from UNITS-1 closed too). deriveAdaptedUnitsFromSession import is gone from ServerMatchHost.ts; the only remaining engine-path use is inside deriveServerAdaptedUnits for custom units (SQLite reader, not HTTP). Test rows co-op=false/true assert fetch never called, journalPlayerUnits/journalOpponentUnits populated by id, and a real Move declared and persisted. Mutants M1 (HTTP for co-op, [] otherwise), M9 ([] for non-co-op) and M10 (sides swapped) caught. |

| CF-MPRU-3: live rewind rebuild does not use HTTP-to-self | YES. Mutant M7 (revert to fromSessionAsync) and M8 (drop the journalRandomSeed stamp) caught by the serverUnits row, which runs a REAL activated branch (appendCommandBatch + commitGmCombatRewind on a real SQLite journal) and asserts fetch not called, prefix ids, capabilities and the reset-protocol order. |

| CF-MPRU-4: post-restart dice from the crypto RollCapture, events record the captured rolls, not predictable from SeededRandom(0xc0ffee) | YES for boot-recovered hosts (every MatchRecovery arm ends in ServerMatchHost.recover). The engine callback is () => host.capture.d6(); the host constructs ServerMatchHostCapture(undefined) = CryptoDiceRoller; installFreshCapture/stampRollsOnNewEvents run per intent (ServerMatchHostIntent 343/360) BEFORE persist+broadcast, so store and wire carry identical rolls. Test rows seed=undefined/4242 spy CryptoDiceRoller.prototype.d6 (call-through) and assert recorded payload.rolls === consumed crypto values across two separate intents (fresh buffers). Mutants M2 (drop wiring), M3 (construct from the caller session), M5 (helper ignores roller), M11 (crypto but uncaptured) caught. Built-image probe (section 5): post-restart initiative_rolled carries rolls [3,1,6,5]. NOT yet true after a LIVE rewind rebuild (F1 / CF-MPRU2-1). |

| CF-MPRU-2: rewound-at-boot fixture | YES, real and unmocked (legacyBranches row 1): real journal, real commitGmCombatRewind, real recoverActiveMatches with HTTP refused; asserts servedBranchId = activated branch, prefix ids, Movement phase, capabilities present, no fetch. Mutants M12 (fromSessionAsync in the rewound arm) and M13 (drop adoptServedBranch) caught - so M8 from UNITS-1 would now be caught. Limit: the Move is refused with rollback-reader-blocked:missing-journal-head (pre-existing fence), so an ACCEPTED action at that crash point is not witnessed (CF-MPRU2-2). |
| M1 | recover: co-op units via engine deriveAdaptedUnitsFromSession (HTTP), non-co-op [] (the pre-PR shape) | CAUGHT (2: both Move rows) |
| M2 | recover: pass undefined instead of () => host.capture.d6() | CAUGHT (2: both dice rows) |
| M3 | recover: construct the host from the caller's session, discard the rebuilt one | CAUGHT (2: both dice rows) |

| M6 | helper: d6Roller ?? SeededD6Roller(seeded ? seed : 0xc0ffee) (unseeded default gets a seeded roller) | SURVIVES - equivalent at the server surface: after this PR the unseeded no-roller branch is reached only by rebuildSessionFromEvents (no production caller) and the discarded MatchRecovery pre-derivations; same as UNITS-1's R9 |
| M7 | live rebuild: revert to InteractiveSession.fromSessionAsync(seeded, readServerCustomCombatDefinition) | CAUGHT (1: serverUnits fetch assertion) |
| M8 | live rebuild: drop the journalRandomSeed stamp (recover from folded) | CAUGHT (1: parity vs seed 4242 control) |
| M9 | recover: units only for co-op (non-co-op []) | CAUGHT (1: co-op=false Move row, journal unit ids) |

Decide crypto-vs-journalDiceSeed provenance, then route through the capture so rolls are recorded. |

items.status: open; registered by #2310; released to planned by this closure
items.item: Live rewind rebuild still uses predictable, uncaptured SeededD6Roller(0xc0ffee). The registered narrow rewind-port/capture unit owns provenance, captured event rolls, and re-sealing the affected test before the GM-rewind path is claimed for v2.2.0. This closure releases but does not implement it.
A rewound-at-boot accepted action remains fenced by rollback-reader-blocked:missing-journal-head. The real boot fixture verifies hydration and refusal, not an accepted action at that crash point.
Co-op restart on a built image must witness an accepted unit action and captured rolls on the first post-restart roll event. The source review built-image probe covers ordinary 1v1 only.
Boot currently derives units three times. A future MatchRecovery.ts owner may remove redundant derivations while preserving custom-unit behavior, journal unit arrays and capture wiring.

carryForwards.registration: Root subsequently registered MP-REWIND-DICE-1 in #2310 (main 59004af9c). This closure computes its release from the ledger and routes CF-MPRU2-1 there; it registers no new unit or dependency edge.

successorRelease.algorithm: Only newly eligible dependents of MP-RECOVERY-UNITS-2; every declared predecessor must be main-verified with a PASS mainProof. Existing independent holds remain. Only state blocked -> planned may change.
